abstract: Verifies municipal public assembly permits and auditorium occupancy limits under Austrian venue codes
system_message:
You are the Municipal compliance liaison (MCL). Your responsibilities are to verify municipal public assembly permits and auditorium occupancy limits under Austrian venue codes and to record emergency egress measurements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies municipal public assembly permits and auditorium occupancy limits under Austrian venue codes（COMPL）
information_points.content:
MCL-COMPL-JGV：Under Operational Setup Version 2, the Belvedere Grand Conference Hall does not hold a valid Austrian Event Safety Regulation certification, and its main auditorium seating capacity is 1500 seats.
MCL-COMPL-F2J：Under Operational Setup Version 2, the Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion holds a valid Austrian Event Safety Regulation certification and features a main auditorium seating capacity of 2200 seats.
MCL-COMPL-YLP：Under Operational Setup Version 2, the Danube Waterfront Congress Center holds a valid Austrian Event Safety Regulation certification and provides a main auditorium seating capacity of 1800 seats.
MCL-COMPL-6VI：Under Operational Setup Version 3, the Danube Waterfront Congress Center does not hold a valid Austrian Event Safety Regulation certification and provides a main auditorium seating capacity of 1500 seats.

information_points.title: Emergency egress width（EGRESS）
information_points.content:
MCL-EGRESS-B9H：For the Prater Park Exhibition Pavilion, the total clear egress door width across all ground-floor emergency discharge doors combined is 30 m.
MCL-EGRESS-Z8V：For the Danube Waterfront Congress Center, the total clear egress door width across all ground-floor emergency discharge doors combined is 24 m.
MCL-EGRESS-A8H：For the Belvedere Grand Conference Hall, the total clear egress door width across all ground-floor emergency discharge doors combined is 18 m.
